description: With sis.frag_size 2 the S_UNIDATA_REQUEST_CONFIRM carries only the first two bytes of the U_PDU, and its size field says 2; with sis.confirm_wait_ms unset the wait runs to the U_PDU's TTD.
note: Link setup and data path as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ with node delivery confirmation (Service Type 0x14), its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST of 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 is held for a soft link while the CAS calls, and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link and the U_PDU goes down to the CAS (A-0194, A-0217 to A-0220); at 108000 it goes on air in one DATA-ONLY, and at 118350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. On acceptance the U_PDU asked for confirmation and is held for a soft link, so its wait runs to its TTD, 0 + 648000 x 2000 ms (interp A-0232, A-0342): sis.confirm_wait starts with 1296000000 ms, the only entry in the deadline list. sis.confirm_wait_ms is unset, so after the U_PDU is handed to the CAS at 91000 its wait still ends at its TTD (interp A-0342): the deadline is unchanged and nothing is emitted for it. At 126000 the peer's ACK-ONLY acknowledges FSN 0 and the CAS confirms: S_UNIDATA_REQUEST_CONFIRM carries destination SAP 9, address 0.0.1.3, size 2 and 'pi', the first U_PDU_response_frag_size bytes of 'ping' (A-0098 to A-0102; interp A-0341), then sis.confirm_wait is cancelled and sis.soft_link_idle starts. Fixture, addresses and draws as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block; seed 0 draws 15, 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
